quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Count up to 14 in your head, saying each number word as you go.
quests.explanation: The numeral 14 is written in words as "Fourteen" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: When you can read big math words like 'Fourteen', you are becoming a true math master!

quests.hint: Count up from 8: "8, ...?"
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 8 is 9 -- one more than 8!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 9 comes right after 8!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Break the word into parts -- does it sound like a small number, a "teen", or a bigger one?
quests.explanation: "Eight" is how we say the number 8 in English, so 8 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: The word 'Eight' has exactly 5 letters in it!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 2 in a line?
quests.hint: Count places in order: 1st, 2nd, 3rd... keep going until you reach position 2.
quests.explanation: Position 2 in a line is called the "Second" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: You use the word 'Second' to show someone's place in a line or a race!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Say the word out loud, then look for the matching numeral among the choices.
quests.explanation: "Thirteen" is how we say the number 13 in English, so 13 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: In English, the number 13 is spelled as 'Thirteen'!

quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach first is the answer.
quests.explanation: 9 is smaller than 14 -- when counting up, 9 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 9, you get 10!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 2 in a line?
quests.hint: This word tells you WHERE something is in line, not how many there are in total.
quests.explanation: Position 2 in a line is called the "Second" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: Knowing ordinal words like 'Second' helps you give exact directions!

quests.hint: The next number is always one more than the number you're on.
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 13 is 14 -- one more than 13!
quests.funFact: If you had 14 apples and found one more, you would have 15 apples!

quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 13 is greater than 10 -- when counting up, 13 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 13 by 10, it becomes 130!

quests.hint: Count them in small groups of two or three, then add the groups in your head.
quests.explanation: Counting one by one gives 8 bees in total -- 8 is the matching number!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 8, you get 9!

quests.hint: Count down from 15: "15, ...?"
quests.explanation: Counting backward, the number right before 15 is 14 -- one less than 15!
quests.funFact: The number 14 is an even number!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Read the numeral 8 out loud -- what word do you say?
quests.explanation: The numeral 8 is written in words as "Eight" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: In math, knowing how to read words like 'Eight' is just as important as knowing the digits!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!

quests.explanation: "Nine" is how we say the number 9 in English, so 9 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 9 by 10, it becomes 90!

quests.hint: Count up one step at a time starting from 12.
quests.explanation: 13 sits exactly between 12 and 14 -- one step up from 12 and one step down from 14!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 13 comes right after 12!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!

quests.hint: Say the numbers in order: 10, then ..., then 12.

quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 11 comes just before 12!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!

quests.explanation: The numeral 12 is written in words as "Twelve" -- that's its name!

quests.hint: Count up from 9: "9, ...?"
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 9 is 10 -- one more than 9!
quests.funFact: Double 10 is 20! Because 10 + 10 = 20.

quests.hint: Tap every picture once, counting "one, two, three..." as you go.
quests.explanation: Counting one by one gives 11 flowers in total -- 11 is the matching number!
quests.funFact: Counting every single picture here one by one gives us exactly 11!

quests.hint: Count down from 15: "15, ...?"
quests.explanation: Counting backward, the number right before 15 is 14 -- one less than 15!
